clue.text: Garment going with formal hat

indicators.note: one piece goes along with the other, set side by side to build the word

parts.note: a top hat is the tall formal hat worn with morning dress
a coat is an outer garment

explanation.surface: A fashion note on which outer garment to wear with a top hat.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: TOP (top hat) goes with COAT, and the overcoat it builds is what one wears with a formal hat.
explanation.definitionFit: An overcoat worn over a suit is the natural partner for a top hat in formal dress.

clue.text: Sound of horn outside spring month and I go right down into bed

definitions.text: I go right down into bed

indicators.note: the horn's sound wraps around the month, sitting outside it

parts.note: a horn makes a toot
Apr is the abbreviation for April, a month of spring

explanation.surface: A rambling instruction about a horn blast, an April day and someone heading to bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' is a flower bed or the soil, not a bed to sleep in; the clue speaks as the root itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant's main root grows straight down deep into the soil of its bed.

clue.text: Polish rising after Italian during game with Communist authority

indicators.note: the Italian and the rising polish sit within the game, during it

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback

indicators.note: the reversed polish is placed after the Italian

parts.note: It is short for Italian, as in Italian vermouth

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to polish is to rub

explanation.surface: Someone polishing during an Italian match while dealing with the Communist powers.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rising' reads the polish upwards; 'Polish' looks like the nationality but is the verb, and 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Politburo was the chief policy-making committee of a Communist party, such as in the Soviet Union.

clue.text: Cat of little weight

definitions.meaning: the snow leopard is also called the ...
an imperial unit of a small mass, one sixteenth of a pound

explanation.definitionFit: The ounce is another name for the snow leopard, and also a small unit of weight.

clue.text: Be careful with analgesics?

parts.note: the idiom for making a great effort is read literally as swallowing painkillers

explanation.definitionFit: To make a great effort is to be thorough and careful, and literally swallowing remedies for aches.

clue.text: Informal wear for football hooligans

definitions.meaning: relaxed everyday clothes
a British subculture of fashion-conscious football hooligans who wore designer sportswear

explanation.definitionFit: Casual clothes are relaxed attire, and in Britain the name also covers well-dressed football thugs of the 1980s.

clue.text: Old king, a model humanist

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry monarch of the nursery rhyme
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A description of a former king as a perfect example of humanism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' looks like an adjective meaning ideal; it is the Model T Ford.
explanation.definitionFit: John Colet was an English Renaissance scholar, Dean of St Paul's and founder of St Paul's School.

clue.text: She could do with a cuddle: I'm on the list

indicators.note: the letters could be done over, reworked into another order

explanation.surface: A woman needs affection, and a voice says it has been put on a list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could do with' rearranges SHE and CUDDLE together; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something planned and entered in a timetable is said to be on the list of events.

clue.text: Priest wielding an oar

indicators.note: wielding an oar suggests swinging it around, so its letters are tossed into a new order

explanation.surface: A clergyman brandishing an oar.
explanation.walkthrough: Aaron, brother of Moses, was the first high priest of the Israelites.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.

clue.text: Quite extensive, wallpaper should be

definitions.meaning: fairly large
size is a glue-like paste for wallpaper, so paper should be fit for sizing

explanation.definitionFit: A sizable thing is fairly big; split as size-able, it describes paper that can take size paste.

clue.text: Structure followed audibly by the agony

definitions.meaning: a tall steel tower carrying power lines
said before 'the agony' the word sounds like the idiom for exaggerating suffering, pile on the agony

explanation.definitionFit: A pylon is a tall framework tower; heard ahead of 'the agony' it makes the phrase meaning to exaggerate distress.

clue.text: Frequency with which king struck oil is damaging, they say

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: the oil is knocked about, as if struck, so its letters change places
they say signals that a word is heard spoken rather than as spelt

parts.note: something that is damaging hurts

explanation.surface: A king strikes oil, and people say that is harmful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struck' rearranges OIL into ILO; HURTS spoken sounds like HERTZ, the unit of frequency.
explanation.definitionFit: A kilohertz is a thousand cycles per second, a unit used to measure frequency.

clue.text: I was there when it happened, which is awkward

definitions.text: I was there when it happened
definitions.meaning: present at the very place of the event
put in a difficult position

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means present at the scene, and also put in a tricky position where an answer is needed at once.

clue.text: Star of the Swan Valley, second class

parts.note: a dene is a narrow wooded valley
B is the grade below A, second class

explanation.surface: A star performer at a Swan Valley venue, ranked second class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swan Valley' looks like one place name; 'Swan' finishes the definition (the constellation Cygnus) and 'Valley' starts the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Deneb is the brightest star in Cygnus, the constellation of the swan.

clue.text: Dealings especially negative, with transport

definitions.meaning: mostly heard in the negative phrase 'have no ... with', having no dealings
a lorry or wagon

explanation.definitionFit: Truck means dealings, mostly in 'have no truck with', and it is also a heavy goods vehicle.

clue.text: Two predators of the first flight?

parts.note: a kitty is a cat, a hunter of mice
a hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A question about two hunters and which of them flew first.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wright brothers made the first powered flight at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, in 1903.
explanation.definitionFit: Powered flight began on the North Carolina dunes where the Wright brothers flew in 1903.

clue.text: Too hard -and it's no use taking more water with it

definitions.meaning: a problem that cannot be solved

definitions.text: it's no use taking more water with it
definitions.meaning: a substance that will not dissolve gains nothing from more liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A problem that cannot be solved is beyond answer; a substance that will not dissolve resists any amount of liquid.

clue.text: Dope and gin to catch the over thirties?

parts.note: speed is slang for an amphetamine drug
a gin is a snare or trap for animals

explanation.surface: Drugs and gin as bait for catching middle-aged people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the over thirties' are not people past thirty but drivers above 30 mph.
explanation.definitionFit: Police radar checks are set up to catch motorists going faster than the limit, such as 30 mph.

clue.text: Indian food on the increase in US city

parts.note: a balti is a curry dish cooked and served in a wok-like pan
more means rising in amount

explanation.surface: Indian food growing popular in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: A balti is a curry popular in British curry houses.
explanation.definitionFit: Baltimore is a large port city in Maryland.

clue.text: Aesthetic' discernment could be to do with Gates

indicators.note: the letters could be arranged otherwise, a hint that they are mixed up

explanation.surface: A remark that refined judgment might have something to do with Bill Gates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges TO DO and GATES; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Refined aesthetic judgment is the ability to tell what is fine or elegant.

clue.text: Looks at the box to protect the eyes

definitions.meaning: the goggle-box is British slang for the television, so to goggle is to stare at it
protective glasses for swimming or welding

explanation.definitionFit: To goggle is to stare, as at the TV; the plural also names protective eyewear.

clue.text: Greek island, from the international rendering

parts.note: de is Spanish for from
los is a Spanish word for the, plural

explanation.surface: A Greek island named in a foreign rendering of a phrase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'international rendering' tells the solver to translate 'from the' into Spanish, de los.
explanation.definitionFit: Delos is a small Cycladic island, sacred in myth as the birthplace of Apollo and Artemis.

clue.text: Woolly not wanted workers

definitions.meaning: a knitted jumper
an employer who exploits workers, someone workers do not want

explanation.definitionFit: A knitted jumper is a woolly; a sweater is also a boss who overworks staff for low wages.

clue.text: Repel prey by talking too much?

indicators.note: to repel is to drive back, so the word is turned backwards

parts.note: a hunter's bag is the game it has killed

explanation.surface: Someone driving off a predator just by chattering.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who chatters a lot is talkative.

clue.text: A party to throw away the earth goddess

parts.note: to bin something is to put it in the rubbish
Ge, or Gaia, is the Greek goddess of the earth

explanation.surface: A party at which the earth goddess is thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: A binge is a bout of heavy eating or drinking, a spree.

clue.text: Fancy cake for take-away in US state

indicators.note: the take-away goes inside the state

parts.note: Maine is a north-eastern US state
dele is the proofreader's mark to take away text

explanation.surface: A fancy cake bought as a take-away somewhere in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take-away' looks like a carry-out meal; it is the proofreader's DELE, an instruction to delete.
explanation.definitionFit: A madeleine is a small shell-shaped French sponge cake.

clue.text: Dr Hill's wheels

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor
a tor is a rocky hill

explanation.surface: A doctor named Hill and the car he drives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dr Hill' looks like a person; it is a doctor (MO) and a hill (TOR).
explanation.definitionFit: Wheels is slang for a car.

clue.text: Catch a girl with love

parts.note: a lass is a girl
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Winning a girl's love.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso is a rope with a noose for catching cattle; as a verb it means to rope in.

clue.text: Gaunt actors entering the road to the right

indicators.note: the actors go into the road

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road
a cast is the company of actors in a play

explanation.surface: Thin actors walking onto the road on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gaunt' looks like thin; it is John of Gaunt, Duke of Lancaster.
explanation.definitionFit: John of Gaunt, son of Edward III, held the title Duke of Lancaster.

clue.text: Talk on pot

definitions.meaning: to hold forth at length
the lip of a teapot from which the tea pours

explanation.definitionFit: To spout is to talk on and on; the same word is the pouring tube on a teapot.

clue.text: Talker needed: ask peer perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters may be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: A request to ask a member of the House of Lords to address the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A speaker is anyone who talks, as at a meeting.

clue.text: First to find one in support

indicators.note: the word for one sits inside the support

parts.note: a pier is a pillar supporting a bridge or arch
taken as written

explanation.surface: A discovery of a person inside a supporting structure.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer is the first to explore or settle somewhere.
